body:
**requirement**
V9.1.2 Verify that HTTP Strict Transport Security headers are included on all requests and for all subdomains, such as Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=15724800; includeSubdomains.

**recommendation**
As all other "response header" related "hardening" requirements are in "14.4 Hardened Configuration", this requirement also belongs there.
title: V9.1.2 hsts - move to V14.4 configuration hardening
